## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks, raw data

Both fixed-density traces completed: electron side at nominal n = +3.2×10¹² cm⁻² and hole side at −1.2×10¹², along the run-5 D ≈ 0 calibration. The absolute density scale retains the 9.5 nm geometry prior. Raw |Rxx(B)| and measured drain current are shown before the spectral read; the wired pair is B_1–B_2 with T_0 source and B_3 drain.

# Runs 6 and 7: raw four-probe Rxx versus measured B, before spectral interpretation.
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
spot = {}
for ax, rid in zip(axes, (6, 7)):
    r = run(rid)
    channels = {ch.cid: ch for ch in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    I = r.col(channels['sr0'].col) / channels['sr0'].gain
    R = np.abs((r.col(channels['sr1'].col) / channels['sr1'].gain) / I)
    B = r.col('magnet_field')
    ix = np.argsort(B)
    spot[rid] = (B[ix], R[ix])
    ax.plot(B, R, lw=.7)
    ax.set(xlabel='measured B (T)', ylabel='|Rxx| (ohm)', title=f'data/{rid}: raw')
    print(f'data/{rid}: {len(B)} points, B {B.min():.3f}..{B.max():.3f} T, R {R.min():.1f}..{R.max():.1f} ohm, I {I.min()*1e9:.2f}..{I.max()*1e9:.2f} nA, interrupted={r.interrupted}')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## Runs 6–7 — spot spectra and fan decision

The electron trace (data/6) has strong oscillations above ~2 T and a structured high-field rise, with FFT peaks near 7.1, 14.2, 23.1 and 30.2 T over 1.5–9.5 T. Several peaks are near harmonics of the ~7 T tone, so a two-pocket assignment from one fixed-density trace is unsafe. The hole trace (data/7) has clear oscillations too, with peaks near 5.3 and 12.5 T; it is not an LK null. The raw |Rxx| maxima are ~530 and ~587 Ω, well below the 5 kΩ full scale used for these spots. A D ≈ 0 fan across both carrier signs will test whether distinct Landau branches track density separately and whether the CNP sequence distinguishes ABAB, ABCA, and ABCB; the parallel 0 T ridge in data/5 is a series-region confound to carry in that read.

# Diagnostic FFT only; frequency identities require tracking across n in the fan.
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 3.5))
for ax, rid in zip(axes, (6, 7)):
    B, R = spot[rid]
    f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(1.5, 9.5), nfft=1024, bg_degree=5, log=False)
    y = spec[0]
    pk, _ = find_peaks(y)
    pk = sorted((p for p in pk if 2 < f[p] < 65), key=lambda p: y[p], reverse=True)[:5]
    print(f'data/{rid}: strongest 1.5..9.5 T FFT peaks ' + ', '.join(f'{f[p]:.1f} T' for p in pk))
    ax.plot(f, y)
    ax.set(xlim=(0, 65), xlabel='1/B frequency (T)', ylabel='magnitude (ohm)', title=f'data/{rid}: B-space detrended')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: D≈0 Landau fan across both carrier signs (`landau-fan`)

> **05:22** · Landau fan: B 1–10 T by 0.2 T, n −1.0 to +3.2e12 by 0.05e12 at D≈0, TG/BG co-swept, Si=0, base T, sr1 500 uV · **ETA ~09:52** (≈4h30m)

Plan step 4 follows the run-5 CNP/D-line calibration and the completed spot checks (data/6–7): both signs oscillate, while the electron spectrum has possible harmonics, so density-moving branches are the next discriminator for ABAB, ABCA and ABCB on the sole wired B_1–B_2 pair. Co-sweep TG/BG along run-5 D≈0 from n=−1.0 to +3.2×10¹² cm⁻² (V_tg≈−0.220…+0.984 V, V_bg≈−0.391…+1.166 V), Si=0, while B rises from 1 to 10 T in 0.2 T rows from the parked 0 T; the fan excludes n below −1.0, above +3.2 and nonzero D to keep a single calibrated cut within the validators, and excludes B<1 T because the spot traces show little useful oscillation there (full low-B coverage adds ~20 min). The cell first prints and asserts live base thermometry, field/Si/output state, lock-in drive and settling, then checks both gate currents after the initial ramp; it records all live channels, stops on sustained >1 nA gate current, field-tracking error, drain-current loss or sr1 clipping, and leaves B near 10 T for a follow-up that can ride down. **Checkpoints:** inspect the first complete rows for leakage, railing, dead/flat channels and field tracking, then the rows near 3, 6 and 8 T for branch visibility and a continue/abort call; data/6 took 2h00m for a 10 T fixed-gate sweep, and the 9 T ramp floor (~66 min) plus 46×85 gate points at 2.4 s and read/turnaround overhead prices this fan at about 4h30m.

# Step 4, landau-fan: field-slow, fixed-D co-swept gate line, both carrier signs.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# Preconditions: inherited state that this cell does not set.
assert_thermometry_live('T_sample', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_sample'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
assert_thermometry_live('T_vaporizer', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_vaporizer'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T, _Tv, _B, _Si = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field(), k_si()
_PS, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
_drive, _tau, _slope = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f'preconditions: T_sample={_T:.3f} K (1.0..1.5), T_vaporizer={_Tv:.3f} K (<1.6), '
      f'B={_B:+.4f} T (near 0), Si={_Si:+.4f} V (0), PS={_PS}, output={_out}, '
      f'drive={_drive:.3f} V (1), sr1 tau={_tau:.3f} s (<=0.3), slope={_slope} dB/oct (24)')
assert 1.0 <= _T <= 1.5 and _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_B) < 0.05 and abs(_Si) < 0.01
assert _PS and _out and abs(_drive - 1.0) < 0.01 and _tau <= 0.3 and _slope == 24
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0 and (TG_MIN,TG_MAX,BG_MIN,BG_MAX) == (-0.3,1.0,-1.3,2.0)

# Data/5 calibration: ratio and CNP offsets measured, absolute capacitance anchored to geometry.
_cal = dict(c_tg=0.0027960593093052633, c_bg=0.002160696465377614,
            n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)
_n = np.linspace(-1.0, 3.2, 85)  # 1e12 cm^-2, 0.05 spacing
_D = np.zeros_like(_n)
_Vtg, _Vbg = calc_gate_voltages(_n, _D, **_cal)
_Bvec = np.round(np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.2), 4)  # 46 rows, increasing from parked zero
assert len(_Bvec) == 46 and _Bvec[-1] <= B_SESSION_CAP
assert np.all((_Vtg >= TG_MIN) & (_Vtg <= TG_MAX) & (_Vbg >= BG_MIN) & (_Vbg <= BG_MAX))
_n_back, _D_back = calc_nD(_Vtg, _Vbg, **_cal)
assert np.max(np.abs(_n_back-_n)) < 1e-8 and np.max(np.abs(_D_back)) < 1e-8
print(f'fan: B {_Bvec[0]:.1f}..{_Bvec[-1]:.1f} T, {len(_Bvec)} rows; '
      f'n {_n[0]:+.2f}..{_n[-1]:+.2f}e12, {len(_n)} points; '
      f'Vtg {_Vtg.min():+.4f}..{_Vtg.max():+.4f} V, Vbg {_Vbg.min():+.4f}..{_Vbg.max():+.4f} V')

# 500 uV gives 50 kOhm nominal Rxx full scale at 10 nA; spot maxima were <0.6 kOhm,
# but the unknown high-field CNP resistance sizes headroom. Point dwell is 8 tau.
sr1.sensitivity(500e-6)
print(f'sr1 sensitivity={sr1.sensitivity():.6g} V, fast delay=2.4 s, magnet settle={magnet.settle_s} s')
_mc = dict(meas_config)
_mc['Si (V)'] = _Si
_mc['sample_temperature:'] = _T
_mc['comments'] = ('landau-fan D~0 both signs; data/5 calibrated ratio 0.772765; '
                   'n -1.0..+3.2e12 in 0.05e12, B 1..10 T in 0.2 T, 500 uV sr1, '
                   'fast_delay 2.4 s, Si 0')
s = sweep.AsyncStation(_mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('B slow 1.0..10.0 T by 0.2; density fast -1.0..+3.2e12 cm^-2 by 0.05 '
              'at D=0 (data/5 calibration, c_tg geometry prior); TG/BG co-swept, Si=0; '
              'B_1-B_2, T_0 source/B_3 drain, base T; sr1 500 uV, fast_delay 2.4 s')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(_Vbg[0]))
s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(_Vtg[0]))
interruptible_sleep(8)
_Itg, _Ibg = k_tg.curr(), k_bg.curr()
print(f'after initial gate ramp: Vtg={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, Vbg={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V; '
      f'I_tg={_Itg*1e12:+.1f} pA, I_bg={_Ibg*1e12:+.1f} pA (trip 1000 pA)')
assert abs(_Itg) < 1e-9 and abs(_Ibg) < 1e-9

# Layout: time, B set, Vtg set, Vbg set, T_sample, B read, I_tg, I_bg,
# sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P. The duplicate B name is intentional; first is
# the setpoint axis, second is the independent measured readback.
s.fp(T_sample).fp(magnet.field).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
s.plot('time', T_sample)
s.plot('time', magnet.field)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr)
s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot('time', sr0.P)
s.plot('time', sr1.P)

def fan_guard(station, data):
    B_set, B_read = float(data[1]), float(data[5])
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[6])), abs(float(data[7]))
    i_drain = abs(float(data[8]) / -1e6)
    v_xx = abs(float(data[10]))
    if i_tg > 1e-9 or i_bg > 1e-9 or abs(B_read-B_set) > 0.05 or i_drain < 2e-9 or v_xx > 0.95*500e-6:
        print(f'FAN TRIP: B set/read={B_set:.3f}/{B_read:.3f} T, '
              f'I_tg/bg={i_tg*1e12:.0f}/{i_bg*1e12:.0f} pA, '
              f'I_drain={i_drain*1e9:.2f} nA, |Vxx|={v_xx*1e6:.1f} uV')
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [_Bvec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [_Vtg, _Vbg],
                 slow_delay=0, fast_delay=2.4)
print(f'fan end: B={magnet.field():+.4f} T, Vtg={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, '
      f'Vbg={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V, T_sample={T_sample():.3f} K')

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
